pages.title: Date Night
pages.text: Eight gifts from across the pack say what poppies can't.

pages.title: House Rules
pages.text: She must be $(bold)your tamed companion$() first — poppies still do exactly what poppies have always done (see $(l:orespawn_integrations:bestiary/girlfriend)The Girlfriend$()), and dandelions still mean makeover. Those are hers; we didn't touch them.$(p)Every gift she accepts is consumed once and leaves a small $(bold)permanent$() buff on $(bold)her$() — on her, never on you. You're courting her, not farming her. One of each gift type per girlfriend; a repeat is politely declined and never consumed. The buffs live in her own vital statistics, so they survive death, saves, and Valentine moods.

pages.title: The Gift List
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Rose$() (Biomes O' Plenty) — +1 heart, filled on the spot$(li)$(item)Lavender$() (Biomes O' Plenty) — +5% movement speed$(li)$(item)Pink Daffodil$() (Biomes O' Plenty) — +2 armor$(li)$(item)White Flower$() (Aether) — +10% knockback resistance$(p)Any partner mod that isn't installed simply means that gift never comes up. She doesn't hold missing flora against you.

pages.title: The Gift List, cont.
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Sourceberry$() (Ars Nouveau) — +1 attack damage$(li)$(item)Strawberry Shortcake$() (OreSpawn Delight) — +2 hearts, filled$(li)$(item)Luna Moth Macaron$() (OreSpawn Delight) — +2 armor toughness$(li)$(item)Teddy Bear$() (Decocraft) — +1 heart. Any of the thirteen colors; they share one flag.$(p)And no, handing her the teddy bear does not equip it as a weapon. We checked. She was going to.

pages.title: Milestones
pages.text: Your first gift earns $(thing)First Date$(). Milestones count $(bold)to you$(), and they survive death — every girlfriend keeps her own gift list, but the courtship record is yours.$(li)$(bold)3$() — $(thing)Going Steady$(): her Diary, Vol. II$(li)$(bold)6$() — $(thing)Practically Family$(): Vol. III$(li)$(bold)8$() — the ring becomes an option$(p)Bonus rule: the $(item)Heart Box of Chocolates$() belongs to OreSpawn Delight's kitchen, and she enjoys it on that mod's terms — but Date Night quietly counts it as a ninth milestone. You may skip any one gift and still reach eight.

pages.title: The Ring
pages.text: With eight milestones banked, present a Decocraft $(item)Engagement Ring$(). Rose gold is canon — she said so in Volume III — though gold and silver are also accepted.$(p)She answers with a full heal, the loudest celebration her voice bank can produce, and $(thing)The Question$(): 200 experience, $(item)Her Answer$() in writing, and eight of her mod's own hearts.$(p)Too early? She declines gently and the ring is not consumed. Twice? She taps her ring finger — already spoken for, by you. Carry the trousseau in style: $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/boss_backpacks)the Girlfriend backpack$() exists.
